name: Quarterback Performance Index
purpose: A transparent, opponent-aware college football quarterback performance rating.
description: QPI measures observed quarterback performance rather than future talent or projection.
limitations: QPI is a performance metric, not a projection.
QPI does not fully isolate the quarterback from teammates and scheme.
FCS games without a comparable defensive rating are excluded from QPI v1.0 context calculations.
QPI does not currently perform play-level credit allocation like film-based grading systems.
model_development: Derived from recent historical college football performance data and validated on seasons excluded from model training.
